title: nawf-1998b-dangerzone
label: Simon "Thunderstryke" McQuaid
how: Beat Gorilla with the Thunderstryker after the Psychotic Doctor's chair-shot interference backfired.
note: The title's own 21 September launch battle royal ended with no champion crowned after masked-faction interference; McQuaid won it in a rematch the following week and retained it against "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams on 2 October, the latest document in the wing's own record.

title: nawf-1998b-north-american-tag-team
label: The Mongolian Assassins
how: Won a four-team elimination match over the Crazed Animals, the SuperPowers and Night Patrol; the final fall came when a Night Patrol manager's weapon shot meant for Genghis instead struck Gorilla, drawing a disqualification as Genghis pinned him.
note: The latest document in the wing's own record; no title defense is recorded after the win.
